records.notes: Build-time .NET SDK analyzer failure. Only sentry-dotnet example in the routing dataset, so holding it out leaves zero dotnet examples.

result.reason: The failure is in the .NET SDK's Sentry.SourceGenerators analyzer when used with Visual Studio 2019/UWP. It is not a Sentry SaaS backend or self-hosted issue. An allowed destination such as getsentry/sentry-dotnet is plausible, but the available routing history contains no relevant SDK ownership decision, so a transfer cannot be supported confidently.
result.routing_history_summary: No transfers or comments were recorded. Similar routing results were unrelated provisional STAY examples and confirmed self-hosted transfers, providing no useful ownership precedent for this analyzer issue.
result.historical_evidence: Similar-issue search returned only broad, unrelated Sentry issue/build examples; none matched the source-generator analyzer failure. No supporting issue URL is included.
result.next_action: Have maintainers confirm whether Sentry.SourceGenerators and Visual Studio compatibility are owned by getsentry/sentry-dotnet; transfer there if confirmed, otherwise retain in getsentry/sentry.

records.title: Snuba seems to set timestamp_ms to a max value
records.notes: Self-hosted Snuba/ClickHouse timestamp error. Reporter-selected Product Area was Issues.

result.reason: The issue is explicitly a self-hosted deployment failure tied to the ClickHouse 26.x+ upgrade and Snuba data behavior. It affects the self-hosted installation's backend/UI integration rather than an SDK. Historical routing examples support transferring self-hosted deployment/runtime failures to getsentry/self-hosted.
result.routing_history_summary: No prior transfers or ownership comments. Similar routing data contains confirmed transfers of self-hosted deployment/runtime issues to getsentry/self-hosted, while generic Sentry issues remain in getsentry/sentry.
result.historical_evidence: Confirmed transfers: https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted/issues/3977 (self-hosted ingestion failure), https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted/issues/3963 (self-hosted replay failure), and https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted/issues/4271 (self-hosted taskworker failure). Similar Sentry issues involving Snuba/UI failures include https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/issues/59610, but it is not the same failure and does not outweigh the explicit self-hosted deployment scope.
result.next_action: Transfer should be reviewed by the self-hosted maintainers; investigate the ClickHouse 26.x/Snuba timestamp conversion or sentinel-value handling that produces the out-of-range year.

records.title: sentry import global silently drops all but one ProjectKey per project
records.notes: Self-hosted user, but the root cause cited is in src/sentry (ProjectKey relocation import). A STAY prediction is defensible; a mismatch here is not necessarily an agent error.

result.reason: The issue identifies a concrete defect in Sentry's global relocation import implementation (`ProjectKey.write_relocation_import`), affecting backup/restore semantics. It is not an SDK or deployment-repository issue, and there is no transfer history or ownership dispute. Keep it in getsentry/sentry.
result.routing_history_summary: No transfers or comments were reported. Historical routing examples include a similar relocation/import issue that stayed in getsentry/sentry; self-hosted transfer examples concern deployment/runtime failures and are not applicable here.
result.historical_evidence: The closest relevant historical example is #83702 (https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/issues/83702), a self-hosted-to-SaaS relocation failure classified as Org Relocation and routed STAY provisionally. No retrieved issue demonstrates a same-failure match. Product-area evidence is therefore weak but the failure is explicitly in relocation import code.
result.next_action: Investigate and fix ProjectKey relocation-import uniqueness/upsert behavior, add a regression test covering multiple keys per project, and clarify public-key behavior for same-installation restores. Consider this report a potential duplicate only if an existing issue covering ProjectKey loss during global import is found.

records.title: Taskworker KAFKA_TOPIC_OVERRIDES Ignored

result.historical_evidence: Confirmed transfers: https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted/issues/4241 (taskworker behavior) and https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted/issues/4317 (Kafka production failure). These are relevant routing precedents, though not exact duplicates.
